summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting its Board of Directors' resolution to pay a regular quarterly cash dividend. The aggregate payout is KRW 348,928,026,400 (KRW 740 per share) on 471,524,360 shares, with a record date of April 30, 2026, and payment on May 29, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the dividend is routine and adheres to the group's capital return policy. The filing constitutes a standard capital return event under a foreign private issuer's periodic reporting. Watch for any subsequent changes in dividend policy or payout ratio, but no risk-arb angle is present as this is a recurring distribution.
